arms.INDEPENDENT: Each action receives exactly 164 tail replicates selected from an action-specific deterministic hash ranking.
arms.SHARED_BAD: One shared set of exactly 164 replicates puts all three actions into their tail state simultaneously.

matched_marginal_contract: Each action has exactly the same finite-sample tail count and tail rate in both arms.
nonclaims: The synthetic shared BAD state is not a measured Linux pressure mechanism
The per-action tail rate is a controlled fixture, not a host estimate
No live process receives a signal
The result does not establish that correlated tails are globally better or worse
